Root cause: ALTCHA requires `crypto.subtle`, available only in secure contexts.

- `http://localhost`: browser treats as secure exception; ALTCHA completes.
- `http://172.19.0.1`: insecure origin; `crypto.subtle` is unavailable.
- The worker loads successfully but ALTCHA 1.4.1 leaves its Promise pending, so [admin-login.component.ts](/home/oem/IdeaProjects/testcenter2/frontend/src/app/app-root/login/admin-login/admin-login.component.ts:85) never reaches `.then()` or rejection.

Verified with real worker:

- localhost → resolved
- `172.19.0.1` → timed out, worker asset returned HTTP 200

ALTCHA explicitly requires HTTPS except for localhost: [ALTCHA troubleshooting](https://altcha.org/es/docs/v2/troubleshooting/).

Fix: access non-localhost hosts through HTTPS. Separately, frontend should check `window.isSecureContext && crypto.subtle` before starting ALTCHA and display an error instead of hanging.
